name: wasteland
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Original raster environment background for Last Living Souls, a psychedelic-rock site; this is landscape art only, never a website mockup.
Style/medium: coherent detailed crisp 16-bit pixel-art landscape with visible square pixel edges and an 8-bit spirit. Premium atmospheric retro adventure pixel art, rich tiny environmental detailing, carefully chosen limited colors.
Composition/framing: very wide panoramic 3:1 image, prefer 3072x1024. Lower 35% holds ground and scenery. Upper center has generous uninterrupted dark negative space for content, with landmarks framing left and right. Flat full-bleed landscape image.
Lighting/mood/palette: dark indigo midnight skies, violet alien ruins, magenta/coral/amber bioluminescent mushrooms, mysterious cosmic wonder.
Constraints: no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no characters, no people, no astronauts. No blur, no photorealism, no smooth airbrushed illustration. Crisp square pixel edges throughout.
Primary request: WASTELAND. A desolate alien purple desert. A broken observatory along the left edge, ruined arches and crashed satellites along the lower ground. A huge pale peach ringed planet with intricate small pixel details above the horizon toward the right. First tiny luminous mushrooms emerging in cracks along bottom. Beautiful indigo dusk. Keep upper middle dark and open. Expressive ruins at left and right.
